method_description: How GPU prices are collected and compared on {date} UTC: {count}, {models}, {regions}. USD list rates, GPU shares, Spot and history.
method_api: We collect verified public price sources. Tier A official APIs, including {source}, may be displayed and exported. Tier B public pages are fetched at most once daily and displayed only; tier C is display only and never exported. Tier D is link only, with no fetching. Only tier A rows with export_allowed are in JSON downloads.
method_filters: We request Virtual Machines in NC, ND and NV families across all commercial regions with USD currency, Consumption prices and primary meters. Windows, paid Linux license add-ons, Dev/Test, reservations, savings plans, legacy Low Priority, non-hourly, future-effective, zero-price and invalid meters are excluded. Base VM products without a Windows designation are treated as Linux base-OS list rates.
method_mapping: Known exact ARM SKUs map to documented GPU model, GPU count, vCPU and RAM. Unknown SKUs and conflicting same-date rates are logged and skipped. The most recent effective date wins within a collection. L40S and other unverified sizes are not guessed. Curated coverage is not exhaustive.
method_units: FX uses dated ECB reference rates: EUR ? USD rate, or CNY ? USD rate / CNY rate. Failed refreshes retain the last valid date. Original currency and hourly price remain visible. Monthly prices are never divided into hourly prices.
method_exclusions: Compare verified cloud GPU offers across providers. Headline minima require whole GPUs, standard regions, current effective dates and resolved GPU-hour prices. Tax-included rows are separate; excluded and unknown tax bases are labelled. Verda uses public instance types and separate on-demand and Spot fields. Regions and live stock are unknown. CPU core semantics and RAM byte convention are unverified, so their original descriptions are shown. No authenticated availability endpoint is queried.
method_history: Each UTC day retains the latest observed value per provider, SKU, region and price type. History shows minimum, median (with n) and maximum across eligible standard-region, whole-GPU offers, separately for on-demand and Spot. It is collected observation history, not every intraday change. Coverage changes affect the series. Missing days are never filled; stale rates never enter today's comparisons.
method_snapshot: Stale ? latest fetch failed or is from an earlier day. Cheapest among observed offers only. Coverage depends on the last collection; this is not a global-market minimum.
method_network: Network requests use the approved HTTPS endpoint allowlist, five attempts, backoff, Retry-After and refused redirects. No credentials or network settings are changed. Pages are spaced by at least one second. B/C page adapters are disabled in this phase.
affiliates: Some links may be affiliate links. This does not affect rankings or prices shown. Provider-only cards carry no scraped price and are excluded from every comparison.
not_found_description: The requested page does not exist. Choose a language to browse observed GPU prices.
basis: Minimum = lowest USD list price for this price type among standard-region, whole-GPU offers. Median = median across those offers, with sample count n. Spot discount = 1 − Spot minimum / on-demand minimum on the same eligible universe; minima can be in different regions or SKUs. Missing prices are excluded. Regions = distinct eligible locations; offers = eligible SKU × region × price-type observations. Values are calculated before rounding. Compare verified cloud GPU offers across providers. Headline minima require whole GPUs, standard regions, current effective dates and resolved GPU-hour prices. Tax-included rows are separate; excluded and unknown tax bases are labelled.
no_discount: Spot: no discount in list price
fraction_note: Fractional GPU, {share} share; price normalized to a full-GPU equivalent. VM hourly price is the actual charge; full-GPU model memory is not the allocated VRAM.
provider_live_note: Live price on provider site; not tracked here. GPU models are a curated catalog, not a guarantee of available capacity.
disclosure: Some links may be affiliate links. This does not affect rankings or prices shown.
region_intro: All observed locations are listed below. Whole and fractional allocations are separate. Each price is the minimum within that location and allocation, separated by price type; excluded locations do not enter headline statistics.
region_chart: Cheapest standard regions · whole GPUs · USD/GPU-hour
region_chart_desc: Paired horizontal bars compare on-demand and Spot minima within each eligible region. Missing bars mean no observed price. Labels give the exact displayed values.
sku_intro: Each row is one observed SKU, region and price type. VM USD/hour is the full VM charge. GPU USD/hour divides that charge by GPU count or share. Outbound buttons open official provider documentation or pricing; check quota and capacity with the provider.
faq_cheapest_q: What is the cheapest {model} across providers?
faq_cheapest_a: On-demand: {demand}/GPU-hour. Spot: {spot}/GPU-hour. These are separate observed minima across {regions} standard regions and {offers} eligible whole-GPU offers on {date} UTC. Availability and quota are not guaranteed.
faq_spot_q: How does Spot compare with on-demand?
faq_spot_a: {comparison} Spot can be interrupted. The two minimum prices may refer to different regions or SKUs.
faq_units_q: Does this price buy a whole GPU?
faq_units_a: Headline prices use only sizes with at least one GPU. The SKU tables show the actual GPU count and whole-VM hourly charge. Fractional sizes are listed separately with their share and full-GPU-equivalent normalization.
method_regions: Edge / Extended Zones and restricted locations remain in detail tables but are excluded from headline minima, medians, discounts, history and the comparison table. Restricted badges also cover sovereign clouds outside the public commercial comparison. West India and legacy Jio locations are conservatively excluded by this site's policy; Microsoft's current public-region table does not mark West India as reserved access, and subscription-specific access rules differ. Unknown region IDs default to standard and are logged for review.
method_rounding: Dollar values use two decimals at or above USD 1 and three decimals below USD 1, using unrounded source values for all calculations. Counts n accompany every offer-price median. No discount percentage is displayed when the Spot minimum is at least the on-demand minimum; discounts are never negative.
method_cadence: The collector is designed for daily UTC snapshots. The observed date and collection status on each page are the evidence of freshness; scheduled execution is not guaranteed. Price history appears after at least two observed days and never fills missing days.
method_audit: Every build independently recalculates published prices and statistics from SQLite, checks JSON exports and localized HTML including titles, descriptions, FAQ structured data and charts, and fails on a mismatch. Optional live sampling compares stored VM prices with Azure; a newer effective date is reported as a source update rather than a historical error.
maximum_def: Maximum = the highest price across the same eligible offers. Models tracked = the number of distinct GPU models represented in today's eligible offers.
link_only_note: Link only. No prices are fetched or exported.
stale_provider: Stale ? latest fetch failed or is from an earlier day
note_azure: Azure uses curated Linux GPU SKUs, with primary hourly meters and effective-date checks.
note_linode: Linode joins exact GPU SKUs to the public region/plan availability feed. Regional hourly overrides take priority; VPU devices are excluded. GPU use is rounded up to hours.
note_scaleway: Scaleway uses complete GPU instance rows with hardware metadata. Money units and nanos retain full precision; minutes and seconds are explicitly converted to hours. Legacy aliases, Apple cores and monthly prices are excluded. EUR is converted with dated ECB rates when available; otherwise EUR remains visible without a USD comparison.
note_verda: Verda uses public instance types and separate on-demand and Spot fields. Regions and live stock are unknown. CPU core semantics and RAM byte convention are unverified, so their original descriptions are shown. No authenticated availability endpoint is queried.
